description: Ask a natural-language question about one of the flagship books and get back the most relevant passages from the book itself, with chapter/location citations. Retrieval only — never a generated summary. Pass any recognizable name for "book" (e.g. "Moby Dick", "the Odyssey") — it resolves to the matching route. Available flagship books: alice in wonderland, art of war, count of monte cristo, crime and punishment, don quixote, dracula, frankenstein, great expectations, grimms fairy tales, jane eyre, meditations, moby dick, picture of dorian gray, pride and prejudice, sherlock holmes, iliad, odyssey, republic, time machine, tom sawyer, treasure island, walden, war and peace, wuthering heights. Costs $0.01 via x402 (requires WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY, USDC on Base).
